text_block_list.text:
In the hallway, I spotted Durandal and
Zenno Rob Roy talking together.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my liege.
We were actually just discussing an epic poem starring myself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ancient warriors, Western knights, Japanese samurai.
Across all times and places, stories of honorable heroes—
epics are widely composed.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Naturally, there should be a story about the academy's pride and knight, Lord Durandal, as well! ...Or so I thought!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Now then, continuing where we left off...
If you have any heroic tales that could inspire a story,
please do tell me!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, my heroic exploits, you say? A few come to mind,
for instance—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Whenever a big bug flew into the living room back home, I'd carry it outside on the tip of my sword—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Lugging bags of rice back and forth between home and the coin-operated rice polishing machine, and—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Even I have to admit, that didn't sound epic at all!
Damn it, at this rate...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Then you just have to weave it starting now.
Your very own tale of adventure!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A dragon-slaying epic of felling a monster after a deadly struggle?
Or a hero's tale of rescuing an imprisoned princess?
Weave whatever story you desire.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
T-That does sound exciting, but...
such opportunities don't come around easily—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Then I shall lend you my power.
Be it a bloodthirsty fiend or a mad demon king,
I will wear whatever mask you desire."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, if I could help out too...!
After all, I was the one who suggested it!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks!
I definitely won't let this opportunity go to waste!
choice_data_list: (Is it really okay to go along with this vibe...?)

text_block_list.text: It seamlessly transitioned into a script meeting, and the rough storyline came together—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku... Are you prepared
to become my sacrifice? Princess.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... You destroyed my homeland, and even took my parents...!
Evil Dragon, I will never forgive you!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, rest assured. The dragon's belly is deep and vast—
I am sure the kings and knights I have devoured will all be there to welcome you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
I think the sound effects could be dialed back a little...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, the last remnant of a ruined kingdom—
now is the time to devour it whole!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Who goes there?
To think someone would march into my Pandemonium all alone—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I have no name to give to an evil dragon—
Yet to put the Princess at ease, I shall proudly declare it!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My name is Durandal!
The knight who shall strike you down!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (...That's it!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Gwahahaha, impudent fool!
I shall reduce you to ash with my flames!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Prepare yourself! Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "—No! Forget I said anything!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: A knight worthy of poetic tales shouldn't just slash away—she must display a technique befitting the climax!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I want to come up with a new special move here, but...
Hmm, what kind would be good—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't rely on reason. Listen to the voice of your own passion.
That is what will bring you inspiration—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see, a flash of inspiration...!
If only I had some sort of spark...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...My Liege! Is there any word
that could serve as a hint!?
choice_data_list: "I'll stake everything on this one blow!"
...Like, what you want to eat right now?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate slash... so cool!
I see, sharp 'acceleration' truly is my essence!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the image is coming to me...
A fierce charge, swinging the sword in a wide horizontal slash—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh, no matter what technique you use, my dragon scales shall withstand it!
Come at me without haste!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm going to get a running start, so wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“—Hyaaaaah!!
New special move—”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Lightning-Flame Absolute Ice-Flash Wood Splinter Slash"!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
K—Kekeke, ha ha ha ha!
Splendidly done, knight...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sir Durandal. Our kingdom...
has not fallen after all, has it?
Not while a knight such as you remains.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Come, let us return—Princess.
Back to our homeland—

"...And so, with a bit of dramatic flair added to the details,
the epic was successfully completed."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Lightning-Flame Absolute Ice-Flash Wood"—
Oh, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
O-Oops, went too far—
Waaaahhhhh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: S-Sir Durandal~!

Though a grand blunder was made,
they managed to complete the epic saga after a Take 2—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Wh-What an intensely climactic thing to say...!
I love it! It's so good!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! My liege!
Since it has come to this, let us unleash our new ultimate move together!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Combining the last of your strength with the companion
who shared your journey to unleash a sword technique—
what a truly splendid situation!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
So the Gates of Ruin are to be closed by two hands, is that it?
Heheh, how wonderfully poetic!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, my Liege!
Come, place your hand upon this sword!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Combined Sword—'Conflict of Ouroboros'!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... Fuhahaha...! Two snakes consuming each other's tails, completely incompatible... Are you saying you achieved the contradiction of uniting their power—
choice_data_list: ...Is that really how it is, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... It worked! It worked flawlessly!
The ultimate combination sword technique with my Liege...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That moment... I will never forget it as long as I live!!
In any case, under the guise of defeating the dragon and saving the princess... with a bit (?) of dramatic embellishment mixed in, Durandal's tale was complete.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Power... that surpasses even dragons...!?
Do I truly have such a thing—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, we've supposedly overcome such a difficult journey
to get here... so having a hidden power awaken
at the very end would be pretty cool too!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Awakening, right? Alright!
Haaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Um...!
I believe now is the time to play the sound effect...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...It has arrived! This power...!
Evil Dragon, feast your eyes upon this!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Evil-vanquishing blade—"Dragon-Slaying Coup de Vent"!
Uoooooooh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Guh... GUAAAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... How was that?
Did I pull it off well...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yay!
Thanks to my liege's sound effects,
I got all fired up...!
—And so, wrapped in the assists and kindness of those around her, Durandal's chivalric tale was complete.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
F-Food, you say?
Hmm... But how would I incorporate that into a technique...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it... On the way here,
there was a dango shop that looked delicious.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha!? Speaking of dango...!
A sharp skewer piercing three balls—or rather, a thrust...!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —I've got it! A demonic art capable of slaying even a hundred-headed dragon in a single blow—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Artisan Technique—"Mitarashi Armor-Piercing Triple Thrust"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No, it's definitely working. It's just—
hearing "dango, dango" so many times makes it a bit... *chuckle*

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Now you've got me
wanting to eat some too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Actually, I am too...

...Well, having technically slain the dragon and saved the princess,
everyone went out to celebrate
and ate dango. The end.
